problem_statement: MCUmgr currently only supports a UART transport that uses the SMP-over-console framing (base64-encoded, with start/end delimiters and a CRC). This is heavier and slower than necessary for binary links. A new MCUmgr UART transport is required that carries the raw binary SMP protocol without base64 encoding, without the extra console framing, and without a CRC — accepting raw SMP packets directly from the serial link. A matching in-memory dummy variant of this raw transport is required so the raw behaviour can be unit-tested without any real UART: feeding a raw SMP request into the dummy transport must reassemble it, dispatch it to the SMP command handlers, and produce a correctly-formed raw SMP response (correct header op-code/group/sequence/id/version and correct decoded payload) with no base64/CRC processing.

verification.reason: The statement describes the behaviour well but omits the exact Kconfig option names, the header file path, and the public function names/signatures that the hidden test depends on. These are all public interface details that can be added to the statement without dictating the implementation.

problems.detail: The test uses Kconfig options CONFIG_MCUMGR_TRANSPORT_RAW_DUMMY and CONFIG_MCUMGR_TRANSPORT_RAW_DUMMY_RX_BUF_SIZE (in prj.conf) and CONFIG_MCUMGR_TRANSPORT_RAW_UART (for the raw UART transport), none of which are named in the statement.

The test includes <zephyr/mgmt/mcumgr/transport/smp_raw_dummy.h> and calls seven functions (smp_raw_none of which are named in the statement: smp_raw_dummy_enable, smp_raw_dummy_disable, smp_raw_dummy_clear_state, smp_raw_dummy_tx_pkt, smp_raw_dummy_add_data, smp_raw_dummy_wait_for_data, smp_raw_dummy_get_outgoing). The agent cannot guess these exact names.

The test relies on specific function signatures: smp_raw_dummy_tx_pkt(const uint8_t *data, int len) returning int, smp_raw_dummy_wait_for_data(uint32_t wait_time_s) returning bool, smp_raw_dummy_get_outgoing() returning struct net_buf *. These parameter/return types are not stated.

verification.note: manual check: typo MCUgr corrected to MCUmgr

problem_statement_fixed:
MCUmgr currently only supports a UART transport that uses the SMP-over-console framing (base64-encoded, with start/end delimiters and a CRC). This is heavier and slower than necessary for binary links. A new MCUmgr UART transport is required that carries the raw binary SMP protocol without base64 encoding, without the extra console framing, and without a CRC — accepting raw SMP packets directly from the serial link. A matching in-memory dummy variant of this raw transport is required so the raw behaviour can be unit-tested without any real UART: feeding a raw SMP request into the dummy transport must reassemble it, dispatch it to the SMP command handlers, and produce a correctly-formed raw SMP response (correct header op-code/group/sequence/id/version and correct decoded payload) with no base64/CRC processing.

The dummy raw transport must be enabled by the Kconfig option CONFIG_MCUMGR_TRANSPORT_RAW_DUMMY, with a configurable receive buffer size via CONFIG_MCUMGR_TRANSPORT_RAW_DUMMY_RX_BUF_SIZE. Its API must be declared in the header zephyr/mgmt/mcumgr/transport/smp_raw_dummy.h and expose at minimum the following functions: smp_raw_dummy_enable(void), smp_raw_dummy_disable(void), smp_raw_dummy_clear_state(void), smp_raw_dummy_tx_pkt(const uint8_t *data, int len) returning int, smp_raw_dummy_add_data(void), smp_raw_dummy_wait_for_data(uint32_t wait_time_s) returning bool, and smp_raw_dummy_get_outgoing(void) returning a struct net_buf pointer.
